title: 《船往上游》
logline: 1937年冬长江夜航江轮上，船员夫妻巡查时局、汽笛声中并肩望江，邀你共溯长江旧梦

shots.visual: On the worn wooden deck of a 1937 winter Yangtze night ferry, Xiuzhen counts lined-up life rings under a kerosene hanging lamp, clutching a tattered old handkerchief.

lines.zh: 这救生圈又少了俩，世道不太平啊
lines.en: Two life rings are missing again, these are troubled times.

shots.ttsDirection: 声线沉郁微哑，语速缓滞，气息带江风滞重感，每字稍留气口，衬出冬夜江轮的冷寂肃杀

shots.visual: Chen Haisheng, the 45-year-old boatswain with tanned skin and stubbly white beard, checks thick mooring ropes tied to the bollard, wearing a worn dark blue uniform.

lines.zh: 缆绳绑得牢，咱这船稳得很
lines.en: The mooring ropes are tied tight, our ship is steady as can be.

shots.ttsDirection: 声线粗粝带暖，语速平稳，重音落在劳作惯有的顿挫处，气息沉实，衬出水手长的风霜与可靠

shots.narrationZh: 这班船连夜西行，送人渡乱世
shots.narrationEn: This ferry sails west through the night, carrying people through troubled times.
shots.visual: The camera pans across the ferry deck, showing rows of life rings, wooden bollards, and flickering river lights visible through the misty Yangtze air.
shots.ttsDirection: 声线克制沉缓，语速稍慢，‘连夜’‘乱世’重读，‘渡’字稍拖长带叹息，尾音轻收，藏住时局愁绪

shots.narrationZh: 船往上游走，人往心里回
shots.narrationEn: The ship sails upstream, while people drift back to their hearts.
shots.visual: Chen and Xiuzhen stand side by side at the deck railing, looking out at the distant river lights, Yangtze mist swirling around them as a distant ferry horn sounds.
shots.ttsDirection: 声线放缓放柔，语速轻缓，‘往心里回’重读带暖意，‘回’字尾音稍扬，气息轻浮，像望着江面轻轻喟叹

shots.narrationZh: 邀你登船，共溯长江旧梦
shots.narrationEn: Board the ship and revisit the old dreams of the Yangtze together.
shots.visual: The vintage 1930s Yangtze ferry sails through the misty night river, warm lights glowing from its deck, with text 'Yangtze Memory Vintage Ferry Night Cruise' displayed on screen.
shots.ttsDirection: 声线温润带笑，语速稍快上扬，‘共溯长江旧梦’重读，尾音轻扬带邀约感，气息舒展，衬出旧梦暖意与邀约诚心
